title: Derive the existing servant draft extraction schema from the canonical Research DTO
summary: Derives the servant research proposal extraction schema directly from canonical ResearchPlanCreateRequest DTO rather than maintaining a divergent handwritten schema that permitted arbitrary nested properties under stages while the strict DTO forbade them. Projections into the OpenClaw adapter subset resolve local acyclic $defs references, project nullable anyOf unions into type: [T, null], remove default annotations without dropping validation keywords, enforce additionalProperties: false on stage items, and preserve domain enums for spec_version ('1.0') and stage_type (ALLOWLISTED_STAGE_BACKENDS). Fails closed on cyclic or unknown refs, unsupported general unions, and preserves unsupported constraint keywords for fail-closed adapter validation. Extends tests to verify against actual canonical DTO and actual adapter validator on the three-extra-field counterexample (model, universe, quantity1) and complete valid drafts with routing, dependencies, budget, execution constraints, and nullables.

acceptance_verification.description: The existing servant proposal route must supply its original ResearchPlanCreateRequest schema to the original servant call and replace the divergent handwritten schema with a small local projection into the existing adapter subset; preserve required fields and nullability and numeric/string/array constraints and additionalProperties forbids plus existing version/stage domain enums and existing business validation; no duplicated DTO or independently maintained field list or adapter constraint weakening

Extend the existing servant tests to use the actual canonical DTO and actual adapter validator for the real three-extra-field counterexample plus valid complete stage routing/dependencies and valid optional budget/dataset/execution constraints and nullable fields; original bad draft must remain rejected with zero plan/dispatch while valid draft stores only draft; unknown/external/cyclic refs or non-nullable general unions must fail closed and no constraint may be silently dropped; no real provider or replay is permitted

Only two original production files and the original servant test plus mandatory evidence may change; retain one data-only provider invocation and no execution before actual plan approval; genuine assigned exact-head review and requiredCI and native integration and DONE are mandatory; no VM/deploy/provider/product POST or key retries or new normalizer/fallback/compiler service/cache/setting/API or rewrite of stored provider output
